title.narrative: Strengthening Inclusive STEM Ecosystems and Mobilizing Evidence and Best Practices for Equitable and Inclusive Science Institutions and Policies

description.narrative: This project addresses persistent gender gaps in science, technology and innovation (STI) by fostering inclusive ecosystems. UNESCO will serve as IDRC’s Knowledge Mobilization Partner, leveraging its convening power, global networks, and evidence-sharing platforms to foster institutional reform and engage policymakers in bridging the gap between institutional change and policy-level impact. The key objective is to develop and mobilize robust evidence, foster institutional reform through a peer-learning model and exchange of best practices, and engage policymakers in bridging the gap between institutional change and policy-level impact. Through communities of women scientists in the South, UNESCO’s Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World (OWSD) will work towards strengthening inclusive STEM ecosystems in selected countries in Africa and Latin America. Throughout the project, a sustainable model for national-level gender equality mechanisms in STEM will be tested, refined, and shared. Findings will be communicated for global dissemination and policy advocacy by UNESCO’s Gender Equality in Science Team, at the Section for STI Policy (STIP).
